```{r}
#| label: highlight-numbers
# Each bullet is at most 85 characters including spaces, the journal's limit; the numbers are read from the tables the manuscript writes.
strip <- read.csv("../03.outputs/statewide_strip.csv"); area <- read.csv("../03.outputs/statewide_area.csv")
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f", 100 * x); ak <- area[area$region == "alaska", ]
h <- c("Spruce beetle outbreaks in Alaska kill the tallest stands of large spruce first",
  sprintf("Pre-outbreak Sentinel-1 backscatter classed %s%% of killed and spared stands correctly", pct(strip$acc_VV)),
  "The backscatter level measures stand height, the susceptibility plot studies describe",
  sprintf("A 90 m map covers %s km² of Alaska forest, %s%% of it at or above the threshold", format(round(ak$forest_km2), big.mark = ","), pct(ak$susceptible_km2 / ak$forest_km2)),
  "Public Earth Engine assets give managers the map before the next outbreak")
stopifnot(all(nchar(h) <= 85))
```
